meta.title: Pegasus Documentation
meta.description: Documentation content for the Pegasus theme options, rendered by tpl_docs.php and previewed in the home-page Docs section.
notes: `hidden: true` hides a section everywhere (the docs page, its dot-nav, and the home-page docs preview). Omit (or set false) to show it.
Each section: `eyebrow`, `title`, `sub` (one-line used in the home-page preview), `intro`, optional `image`, and an `items` list of options.
Image `src` is site-root relative. `lightbox: true` wraps the screenshot in a lightbox anchor.
An item may carry its own `image` (used by the additional-header examples).
An item may carry a `code` string (rendered as a code block). It is stored DECODED (real < and >) and escaped at render time so markup/shortcodes display literally.

sections.title: Pegasus Options
sections.sub: Site-wide logo, colors, footer & navigation defaults
sections.intro: Global settings found under Pegasus Options in the WordPress admin. These apply site-wide and are the foundation every page inherits.

items.name: Logo
items.desc: Upload your site logo. Defaults to the Site Title (Settings → General) when left empty.

items.name: Favicon
items.desc: The small icon shown in the browser tab.

items.name: Background color
items.desc: Base background color for the whole site.

items.name: Background Image
items.desc: Optional site background image. Position and mobile rendering may need developer tuning.

items.name: Background Image Repeat
items.desc: No Repeat, Repeat, Repeat-X, Repeat-Y, Space or Round.

items.name: Background Image Position
items.desc: Center Center, Top Left, Top Center, Top Right, Bottom Left, Bottom Center or Bottom Right.

items.name: Background Image Size
items.desc: None, Cover or 100% 100%.

items.name: Background Attachment Fixed
items.desc: Enable to fix the background image for a parallax effect.

items.name: Content color (body, p)
items.desc: Base text color for body copy and paragraphs.

items.name: Footer Widget Areas
items.desc: Choose None, One, Two, Three or Four footer widget columns.

items.name: Top Bar
items.desc: Enable and style the optional top bar above the header.

items.name: Mobile hamburger color & border color
items.desc: Color and border color of the mobile menu (hamburger) toggle button.

items.name: Nav background color
items.desc: Background color of the navbar.

items.name: Nav item color
items.desc: Color of the menu links in the navigation.

items.name: Current item color
items.desc: Color of the active / current menu item.

items.name: Footer options
items.desc: Footer copyright text, horizontal rule, and full-width footer toggles.

sections.title: Header Options
sections.sub: Five header layouts for different logos & menus
sections.intro: Pick one of five header layouts under Header Select. Each suits a different logo size and menu complexity.

items.name: Header One
items.desc: Logo above the navbar, opaque navbar, MegaMenu, and social media menu. Ideal for large menu systems because of its MegaMenu.

items.name: Header Two
items.desc: Logo inside (left of) the navbar, transparent navigation, with a social media menu. Good for small logos and a simple design.

items.name: Header Three
items.desc: Fixed full-width fancy header, transparent navigation, sidebar mobile nav (not good for a lot of menu items), with special page options for a small or large header.

items.name: Header Four
items.desc: Bottom-sticky full-width fancy header, transparent navigation, sidebar mobile nav (not good for a lot of menu items).

items.name: Header Five
items.desc: Fixed left sidebar navigation — the layout this site uses.

sections.title: Additional Header
sections.intro: Used when a page needs extra header spacing or a hero area. Choose the header type under Additional Header Options, then set the overlay color, overlay opacity and NoSpacer padding.

items.name: No Header - No Spacing
items.desc: No page header and no extra top spacing.

items.name: No Header - Just Spacing
items.desc: No header, but adds top spacing (NoSpacer Padding, e.g. 25px 0) so content clears a fixed navbar.

items.name: Small Header (with parallax)
items.desc: A small hero header with an overlay color / opacity and optional parallax background.

items.name: Large Header (full height + width)
items.desc: A full-viewport hero header with an overlay color / opacity.

items.name: Overlay color & opacity
items.desc: Tint the header background with a color and opacity (default 0.4).

items.name: NoSpacer Padding
items.desc: Padding applied when using a no-header spacing option (default 25px 0).

sections.title: Pegasus Page Options
sections.sub: Full-width and page-header overrides per page
sections.intro: Per-page overrides found in the Pegasus Page Options box on each page or post editor. They override the matching global option for that page only.

items.name: Fullwidth Container Checkbox
items.desc: Make the page full-width. This overrides the global full-width theme option.

items.name: Disable Page Header
items.desc: Hide the page header on this page.

sections.title: Primary Navigation
sections.sub: Assign your menu to the Primary Menu location
sections.intro: Build your menu under Appearance → Menus, then assign it to the Primary Menu display location. Set the display location for the primary navigation so each header layout works correctly.

items.name: Display location — Primary Menu
items.desc: Under Menu Settings, check Primary Menu so the menu renders in the header. Every header layout reads from the Primary Menu location.

items.name: Social Icon Menu
items.desc: Assign a menu to the Social Icon Menu location to show social links in the header/footer.

items.name: Mega Menu Columns One–Four
items.desc: For Header One's MegaMenu, assign menus to Mega Menu Column One through Four.

items.name: Auto add pages
items.desc: Optionally auto-add new top-level pages to the menu.

sections.title: Social Media Links
sections.sub: Add Font Awesome social icons to the nav, top bar or footer
sections.intro: Show Font Awesome 4 social icons in the primary navigation, the top bar, or the Footer Social widget. There are two ways to add them: as menu items, or as a Custom HTML widget.

items.name: Primary nav / top bar — build a menu
items.desc: Go to Appearance → Menus and create a new menu. Add a Custom Link and paste the social platform URL. Open Screen Options (top-right) and check "CSS Classes" and "Link Target". Expand the link box, check "Open link in a new tab", then set CSS Classes to a Font Awesome 4 class — for example fa fa-facebook. Repeat for each platform.

items.name: Font Awesome 4 icon classes
items.desc: Put one class in the CSS Classes field of each menu item / link:
items.code:
fa fa-facebook
fa fa-linkedin
fa fa-youtube
fa fa-twitter
fa fa-instagram
fa fa-github
fa fa-medium
fa fa-pinterest
fa fa-tiktok

items.name: Footer Social widget — Custom HTML
items.desc: Go to Appearance → Widgets, open the "Footer Social" widget area, add a Custom HTML widget/block, and paste markup like this (swap in your own URLs). Items without a Font Awesome icon can just use text:
items.code: • Ebay
